# env0_log_forwarding (Resource)

Forwards deployment logs, audit logs or both to an external logging service. An organization has at most one log forwarding configuration per type. The env0 API never returns the configuration value, so Terraform cannot detect changes made to it outside Terraform. An import cannot read the value either: the first apply after an import writes the configured value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deployment logs to Datadog. The API key is a secret reference: `$${...}` escapes Terraform's own interpolation.
resource "env0_log_forwarding" "datadog" {
  type = "DATADOG"
  value = jsonencode({
    host   = "http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com"
    port   = 443
    apiKey = "$${ssm:datadog-api-key}"
  })
  deployment_log_forwarding = true
}

# Audit logs to an S3 bucket, written through an IAM role env0 assumes.
resource "env0_log_forwarding" "s3" {
  type = "S3"
  value = jsonencode({
    bucketName = "my-env0-audit-logs"
    awsRegion  = "us-east-1"
    bucketPath = "env0/audit"
    roleArn    = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/env0-log-forwarding"
  })
  audit_log_forwarding = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) the logging service: SPLUNK, NEWRELIC, DATADOG, SUMOLOGIC, LOGZIO, CORALOGIX, GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOGGING, GRAFANA_LOKI, CLOUDWATCH, S3
- `value` (String, Sensitive) the logging service configuration, as a JSON object (use `jsonencode`). Its fields depend on the type, see https://docs.envzero.com/docs/logs-forwarding. With deployment log forwarding, secret fields must be secret references such as `$${ssm:<name>}` unless the organization allows saving secrets on env0. Not returned by the env0 API, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected

### Optional

- `audit_log_forwarding` (Boolean) forward audit logs (at least one of deployment_log_forwarding and audit_log_forwarding must be true)
- `deployment_log_forwarding` (Boolean) forward deployment logs (at least one of deployment_log_forwarding and audit_log_forwarding must be true)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import env0_log_forwarding.by_id ddda7b30-6789-4d24-937c-22322754934e
terraform import env0_log_forwarding.by_type DATADOG
```
